title: Honey Glazed Carrots
description: Simple stovetop carrots with butter and honey.

steps.text: Put 1 pound sliced carrots and 1/4 cup water in a skillet; cover and simmer 8 minutes.
Remove lid. Add 2 tablespoons butter, 1 1/2 tablespoons honey, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Cook uncovered 4–5 minutes, tossing, until carrots are glossy and tender.

title: Garlic Butter Green Beans
description: Quick tender-crisp green beans with garlic butter.

steps.text: Put 1 pound green beans and 1/4 cup water in a skillet; cover and steam 5 minutes.
Uncover and add 2 tablespoons butter, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Cook 3–4 minutes, tossing, until beans are tender-crisp.

title: Tomato Cucumber White Bean Salad
description: A no-cook bean salad with crunchy vegetables and lemon dressing.

steps.text: Put 1 can drained white beans, 1 cup chopped cucumber, and 1 cup chopped tomato in a bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Toss well and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Red Lentil Soup
description: Soft red lentils simmered with tomatoes, carrots, and warm spices.

steps.text: Put 1 1/2 cups rinsed red lentils, 1 diced carrot, 1 diced onion, 1 can diced tomatoes, 6 cups broth or water, and 1 teaspoon cumin in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft and the soup thickens.
